title_sq: Tek "Lion 2 Residence", Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Planimetri Perfekte !!
description_sq: Tek "Lion 2 Residence", Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Planimetri Perfekte !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 banim te nje kompleksi te ri 34-katesh ne faze ndertimi karabina. Lion 2 Residence eshte nje projekt multifunksional shume afer qendres se qytetit me nje fasade teresisht ekologjike dhe te gjelberuar. Pozicionimi i kompleksit prane rruges kryesore e ben lehtesisht te aksesueshem dhe te pershtatshem si per investim ashtu edhe per banim. Zona ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme. Apartamenti ka orientim Lindje cka i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites dhe me pamje nga Qendra e Tiranes. Organizimi i brendshem eshte si me poshte: hyrja me korridor, salloni i ndenjes i bollshem me dalje ne ballkon i cili te ofron pamje fantastike nga qendra e qytetit, dhoma matrimoniale dhe me dalje ne ballkon dhe tualet me vete, nje dhome gjumi tjeter dhe tualeti i dites.
title_en: At "Lion 2 Residence", 2+1 apartment with perfect floor plan for sale!!
description_en: At "Lion 2 Residence", 2+1 apartment with perfect floor plan for sale!! The apartment is located on the 4th residential floor of a new 34-storey complex under construction. Lion 2 Residence is a multifunctional project very close to the city center with a completely ecological and green facade. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services. The apartment has an East orientation, which allows natural lighting throughout the day and with a view of the Center of Tirana. The internal organization is as follows: entrance with corridor, spacious living room with access to the balcony which offers a fantastic view of the city center, matrimonial room with access to the balcony and its own toilet, another bedroom and the day toilet.
